verdict.rationale: CSC documents some event-triggered automation that users can configure. Incoming service-of-process documents are delivered according to the customer's routing preferences and designated contacts. Good-standing or name changes and filing obligations automatically trigger email alerts, but these are fixed, vendor-defined triggers rather than a general rule builder. missing for 10: user-authored rule/condition builder, configurable actions beyond email alerts and routing, programmatic or AI-native rule definition, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: We'll receive, scan, and deliver your SOP according to your routing preferences and designated contacts.
If an entity's good standing status changes—or if a name change occurs—our Corporate Tracker sends you email alerts notifying you of the change.
The Compliance Calendar® automatically creates calendar events for annual reports and related filing obligations, and proactively sends email alerts
